records.name: AudioVBlank_RestoreCh1
records.comment:
Recover the borrowed pulse channel (CH1 or CH2) from its latched music event.
Pending value 2, disabled music, or a non-note latch silences it instead.
The caller must first establish that the effect has released the channel.

definition.name: AudioVBlank_RestoreCh1
definition.comment:
Recover the borrowed pulse channel (CH1 or CH2) from its latched music event.
Pending value 2, disabled music, or a non-note latch silences it instead.
The caller must first establish that the effect has released the channel.
definition.body:
void AudioVBlank_RestoreCh1()
{
    __asm {
        LD_A_MEM Audio_EffectUsesCh2
        OR_A
        JR_NZ audiovb_restore_ch2
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_RestoreCh1Pending
        CP_IMM 2
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch1_off
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_MusicPlaying
        OR_A
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch1_off
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_MusicEnabled
        OR_A
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch1_off
        LD_A_MEM Audio_MusicEnabled
        OR_A
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch1_off
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_Ch1LatchedNote
        CP_IMM 0x44
        JR_NC audiovb_restore_ch1_off
        LD_C_A
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_Ch1Sweep
        LDH_MEM_A 0x10
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_Ch1Duty
        LDH_MEM_A 0x11
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_Ch1Envelope
        LDH_MEM_A 0x12
        LD_A_C
        LD_E_A
        LD_D_IMM 0
        LD_HL_IMM AudioVBlank_FreqLo
        ADD_HL_DE
        LD_A_HL
        LDH_MEM_A 0x13
        LD_HL_IMM AudioVBlank_FreqHi
        ADD_HL_DE
        LD_A_HL
        OR_IMM 0x80
        LDH_MEM_A 0x14
        JR audiovb_restore_ch1_done
audiovb_restore_ch1_off:
        XOR_A
        LDH_MEM_A 0x12
audiovb_restore_ch1_done:
        JR audiovb_restore_square_done

audiovb_restore_ch2:
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_RestoreCh1Pending
        CP_IMM 2
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch2_off
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_MusicPlaying
        OR_A
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch2_off
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_MusicEnabled
        OR_A
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch2_off
        LD_A_MEM Audio_MusicEnabled
        OR_A
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch2_off
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_Ch2LatchedNote
        CP_IMM 0x44
        JR_NC audiovb_restore_ch2_off
        LD_C_A
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_Ch2Duty
        LDH_MEM_A 0x16
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_Ch2Envelope
        LDH_MEM_A 0x17
        LD_A_C
        LD_E_A
        LD_D_IMM 0
        LD_HL_IMM AudioVBlank_FreqLo
        ADD_HL_DE
        LD_A_HL
        LDH_MEM_A 0x18
        LD_HL_IMM AudioVBlank_FreqHi
        ADD_HL_DE
        LD_A_HL
        OR_IMM 0x80
        LDH_MEM_A 0x19
        JR audiovb_restore_square_done
audiovb_restore_ch2_off:
        XOR_A
        LDH_MEM_A 0x17
audiovb_restore_square_done:
    }
}

records.name: AudioVBlank_RestoreCh3
records.comment:
Recover a latched wave-channel music event after effect release, or disable

The caller owns effect arbitration and clearing the pending flag.

definition.name: AudioVBlank_RestoreCh3
definition.comment:
Recover a latched wave-channel music event after effect release, or disable
the DAC for a release-only request, disabled music, or a non-note latch.
The caller owns effect arbitration and clearing the pending flag.
definition.body:
void AudioVBlank_RestoreCh3()
{
    __asm {
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_RestoreCh3Pending
        CP_IMM 2
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch3_off
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_MusicPlaying
        OR_A
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch3_off
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_MusicEnabled
        OR_A
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch3_off
        LD_A_MEM Audio_MusicEnabled
        OR_A
        JR_Z audiovb_restore_ch3_off
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_Ch3LatchedNote
        CP_IMM 0x44
        JR_NC audiovb_restore_ch3_off
        LD_C_A
        LD_A_IMM 0x80
        LDH_MEM_A 0x1A
        XOR_A
        LDH_MEM_A 0x1B
        LD_A_MEM AudioVBlank_Ch3Level
        LDH_MEM_A 0x1C
        LD_A_C
        LD_E_A
        LD_D_IMM 0
        LD_HL_IMM AudioVBlank_FreqLo
        ADD_HL_DE
        LD_A_HL
        LDH_MEM_A 0x1D
        LD_HL_IMM AudioVBlank_FreqHi
        ADD_HL_DE
        LD_A_HL
        OR_IMM 0x80
        LDH_MEM_A 0x1E
        JR audiovb_restore_ch3_done
audiovb_restore_ch3_off:
        XOR_A
        LDH_MEM_A 0x1A
audiovb_restore_ch3_done:
    }
}

clears targeting, and a target outside the bounds may remain active indefinitely.

records.name: chain_init
records.args: Chain* chain, ChainPoint* storage, u8 capacity
records.signature: void chain_init(Chain* chain, ChainPoint* storage, u8 capacity);
records.comment:
Attach caller-owned ring storage and start with no recorded points.
The storage must remain valid for the lifetime of the chain.
Use a valid chain pointer and capacity entries of caller-owned storage.
Capacity at most 128 keeps every head+age sum in the byte range used by the reader.

records.name: danmaku_clear_map

32 directions, 0=right, 8=down, 16=left, 24=up. speed in 1/16 px.

definition.name: danmaku_clear_map
definition.comment: Clear all 576 bytes with 72 unrolled eight-byte stores. This changes the RAM map, not VRAM.
definition.body:
void danmaku_clear_map() {
    __asm {
        LD_HL_IMM dm_map
        LD_B_IMM 72
        XOR_A
    dm_clm_loop:
        LDI_HL_A
        LDI_HL_A
        LDI_HL_A
        LDI_HL_A
        LDI_HL_A
        LDI_HL_A
        LDI_HL_A
        LDI_HL_A
        DEC_B
        JR_NZ dm_clm_loop
        RET
    }
}

records.name: danmaku_step
records.comment:
Caller fills decoration after clear_map, then calls step to overlay bullets.
hit and graze are events for this step. Collision uses rendered centers.

definition.name: danmaku_step
definition.comment:
Advance active bullets, cull outside 160x128, compute events and OR quadrant IDs into dm_map.
Call clear_map and restore decoration first when old bullet trails should disappear.
definition.body:
void danmaku_step() {
    // One linear pass. No per-bullet bank calls, multiplication or division.
    // The 8-byte packed public layout is x16,y16,vx8,vy8,active,graze.
    __asm {
        XOR_A
        LD_MEM_A dm_hit
        LD_MEM_A dm_graze
        LD_A_IMM 96
        LD_MEM_A dm_remaining
        LD_HL_IMM dm_bullets
    dm_tick_loop:
        PUSH_HL
        LD_BC_IMM 6
        ADD_HL_BC
        LD_A_HL
        OR_A
        JP_Z dm_tick_next
        DEC_HL
        LD_A_HL
        LD_MEM_A dm_vy
        DEC_HL
        LD_A_HL
        LD_C_A
        LD_B_IMM 0
        AND_IMM 128
        JR_Z dm_tick_xsign
        DEC_B
    // B:C is the sign-extended X velocity. Add to Q12.4 position; high byte >=10 also rejects negative X.
    dm_tick_xsign:
        POP_HL
        PUSH_HL
        LD_A_HL
        ADD_C
        LDI_HL_A
        LD_E_A
        LD_A_HL
        ADC_B
        LDI_HL_A
        CP_IMM 10
        JP_NC dm_tick_kill
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        LD_D_A
        LD_A_E
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        AND_IMM 15
        OR_D
        LD_MEM_A dm_px
        LD_A_MEM dm_vy
        LD_C_A
        LD_B_IMM 0
        AND_IMM 128
        JR_Z dm_tick_ysign
        DEC_B
    // Apply signed Y velocity similarly; high byte >=8 rejects negative Y and positions at or below 128 pixels.
    dm_tick_ysign:
        LD_A_HL
        ADD_C
        LDI_HL_A
        LD_E_A
        LD_A_HL
        ADC_B
        LDI_HL_A
        CP_IMM 8
        JP_NC dm_tick_kill
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        LD_D_A
        LD_A_E
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        RRCA
        AND_IMM 15
        OR_D
        LD_MEM_A dm_py
        // Signed differences shifted into 0..16 for a wrap-safe range test.
        // Rendered centers are (pixel & FC)+2. Test a square of radius eight around the player for graze eligibility.
        LD_A_MEM dm_player_x
        LD_C_A
        LD_A_MEM dm_px
        AND_IMM 252
        ADD_A_IMM 10
        SUB_C
        CP_IMM 17
        JR_NC dm_tick_plot
        LD_B_A
        LD_A_MEM dm_player_y
        LD_C_A
        LD_A_MEM dm_py
        AND_IMM 252
        ADD_A_IMM 10
        SUB_C
        CP_IMM 17
        JR_NC dm_tick_plot
        LD_C_A
        INC_HL
        INC_HL
        INC_HL
        LD_A_HL
        OR_A
        JR_NZ dm_tick_check_hit
        LD_A_IMM 1
        LD_HL_A
        LD_A_MEM dm_graze
        INC_A
        LD_MEM_A dm_graze
    // A bullet grazes at most once during its lifetime. Invulnerability suppresses hits, but not first-graze events.
    // The inner hit test uses a square of radius three around the same quantized center.
    dm_tick_check_hit:
        LD_A_MEM dm_invulnerable
        OR_A
        JR_NZ dm_tick_plot
        LD_A_B
        SUB_IMM 5
        CP_IMM 7
        JR_NC dm_tick_plot
        LD_A_C
        SUB_IMM 5
        CP_IMM 7
        JR_NC dm_tick_plot
        LD_A_IMM 1
        LD_MEM_A dm_hit
    // Select one of four quadrant bits from pixel bit 2, then address map[(y>>3)*32+(x>>3)].
    // Decoration IDs >=16 are replaced at occupied cells; bullet IDs 0..15 merge with OR.
    dm_tick_plot:
        LD_A_MEM dm_py
        AND_IMM 4
        AND_IMM 254
        RRCA
        LD_B_A
        LD_A_MEM dm_px
        AND_IMM 4
        AND_IMM 254
        RRCA
        AND_IMM 254
        RRCA
        OR_B
        LD_E_A
        LD_D_IMM 0
        LD_HL_IMM dm_bits
        ADD_HL_DE
        LD_A_HL
        LD_C_A
        LD_A_MEM dm_py
        AND_IMM 120
        LD_L_A
        LD_H_IMM 0
        ADD_HL_HL
        ADD_HL_HL
        LD_A_MEM dm_px
        AND_IMM 254
        RRCA
        AND_IMM 254
        RRCA
        AND_IMM 254
        RRCA
        LD_E_A
        LD_D_IMM 0
        ADD_HL_DE
        LD_DE_IMM dm_map
        ADD_HL_DE
        LD_A_HL
        CP_IMM 16
        JR_C dm_tick_merge
        XOR_A
    dm_tick_merge:
        OR_C
        LD_HL_A
        JR dm_tick_next
    // Restore the saved record base, clear active at offset six and decrement the live count exactly once.
    dm_tick_kill:
        POP_HL
        PUSH_HL
        LD_BC_IMM 6
        ADD_HL_BC
        XOR_A
        LD_HL_A
        LD_A_MEM dm_count
        DEC_A
        LD_MEM_A dm_count
    // Restore the saved base even for inactive or culled bullets, then advance by the fixed eight-byte record size.
    dm_tick_next:
        POP_HL
        LD_BC_IMM 8
        ADD_HL_BC
        LD_A_MEM dm_remaining
        DEC_A
        LD_MEM_A dm_remaining
        JP_NZ dm_tick_loop
        RET
    }
}

records.name: danmaku_present_now
records.comment:
Requires CGB and LCD off or the beginning of VBlank. VBK restored to 0.
Transfers 18 rows (32-byte stride) to BG map 9800 with 36-block GDMA.

definition.name: danmaku_present_now
definition.comment:
Start CGB general DMA for 36 blocks (576 bytes) from aligned dm_map to 9800 in VRAM bank zero.
This synchronous path does not detect CGB, wait for access or preserve the previous VBK value.
definition.body:
void danmaku_present_now() {
    __asm {
        XOR_A
        LDH_MEM_A 0x4F
        LD_HL_IMM dm_map
        LD_A_H
        LDH_MEM_A 0x51
        LD_A_L
        LDH_MEM_A 0x52
        LD_A_IMM 0x18
        LDH_MEM_A 0x53
        XOR_A
        LDH_MEM_A 0x54
        LD_A_IMM 35
        LDH_MEM_A 0x55
        RET
    }
}

records.name: Link4_InitHost

Cooperative 4-player adapter helpers.

This layer models the common host-selected adapter pattern:
- Slot 0 is always the host.
- The host selects one active peer slot at a time.

returns to PING.  A transfer-phase silence timeout schedules the same recovery

records.name: kq2d_scale_q8
records.comment: Truncates toward zero, including negative values; coefficient is -256..256.

definition.name: kq2d_scale_q8
definition.body:
s16 kq2d_scale_q8(s16 value, s16 coefficient)
{
    // Eight-bit shift/add product in HL:C, with sign applied after truncation.
    __asm {
        LD_HL_IMM value
        LD_A_HL
        LD_E_A
        INC_HL
        LD_A_HL
        LD_D_A
        OR_E
        JP_Z kqscale_zero
        LD_HL_IMM coefficient
        LD_A_HL
        LD_C_A
        INC_HL
        LD_A_HL
        LD_B_A
        LD_A_C
        OR_A
        JR_NZ kqscale_fraction
        LD_A_B
        OR_A
        JP_Z kqscale_zero
        LD_H_D
        LD_L_E
        AND_IMM 128
        RET_Z
        JP kqscale_negate
kqscale_fraction:
        LD_A_D
        XOR_B
        AND_IMM 128
        PUSH_AF
        LD_A_D
        AND_IMM 128
        JR_Z kqscale_value_positive
        XOR_A
        SUB_E
        LD_E_A
        LD_A_IMM 0
        SBC_D
        LD_D_A
kqscale_value_positive:
        LD_A_B
        AND_IMM 128
        JR_Z kqscale_coefficient_positive
        XOR_A
        SUB_C
        LD_C_A
kqscale_coefficient_positive:
        LD_HL_IMM 0
        LD_B_IMM 8
kqscale_multiply:
        LD_A_C
        AND_IMM 1
        JR_Z kqscale_shift
        ADD_HL_DE
kqscale_shift:
        LD_A_H
        RRA
        LD_H_A
        LD_A_L
        RRA
        LD_L_A
        LD_A_C
        RRA
        LD_C_A
        DEC_B
        JR_NZ kqscale_multiply
        POP_AF
        OR_A
        RET_Z
kqscale_negate:
        XOR_A
        SUB_L
        LD_L_A
        LD_A_IMM 0
        SBC_H
        LD_H_A
        RET
kqscale_zero:
        LD_HL_IMM 0
        RET
    }
}

Quantizes toward zero; very small limits relative to input may yield zero.
Components and positive max_speed must be <= 16383 in magnitude.

definition.name: kq2d_body_limit_speed

A null body is ignored; a nonpositive limit zeros velocity. This helper ignores
active/mass flags. Components and positive limits must have magnitude <= 16383.

Caller resolves penetration separately. Relative components must fit +/-8191.

definition.name: kq2d_body_resolve_surface
definition.signature: s16 kq2d_body_resolve_surface(KQBody2D* body, const KQSurface2D* surface);
definition.comment:
Resolve incoming velocity relative to a moving surface and return the
positive incoming normal speed; null inputs or separating motion return zero.
Use a Q8 unit normal, nonnegative threshold/kick, and relative components
within +/-8191. This does not detect contact, move positions, or check body mass.

records.name: kq2dc_step
records.comment:
Integrate active dynamic bodies, apply bounds, solve contacts, then damp
velocity and snap components in -1..1 to zero. Zero solver iterations means one.
Pairs with both velocities zero are skipped, so resting overlaps can remain.
Bounds can reposition static bodies; null world/array inputs are ignored.

records.comment:
Store the requested mass; nonpositive mass makes the body static.
For positive mass compute inverse weight as max(1,32767/max(mass,64)).
The stored mass retains the original input; this is a relative solver weight,
not an exact Q8 reciprocal. Null body is ignored.

records.name: kq3d_step
records.comment:
Integrate active dynamic bodies and reset their impact values, then solve
each active unordered pair for the configured passes (zero means one).
Static bodies retain previous impact maxima until the game clears them.
Acceleration persists; flags and break thresholds remain game-owned.
This discrete solver shares non-reentrant ASM scratch and can miss fast crossings.

records.name: kq3d_integrate_body
records.comment:
Reset impact for one active dynamic body, add gravity and persistent body
acceleration, clamp velocity per axis and advance position. Static/inactive
bodies retain impact state. Null inputs are ignored; no contacts are solved.
Use a nonnegative speed limit and avoid overflow before clamping.

definition.name: kq3d_integrate_body

acceleration, clamp velocity per axis and advance position. Static/inactive
bodies retain impact state. Null inputs are ignored; no contacts are solved.
Use a nonnegative speed limit and avoid overflow before clamping.

definition.signature: void text_open(u8 x, u8 y, u8 w, u8 h);
definition.comment:
Set the tile-space window, reset its cursor and redraw it immediately.
Opening does not reset the existing character speed or load font tiles.

records.name: text_close
records.comment: Erase the open window with the fill tile and disable windowed character output.

definition.name: text_close

records.name: text_print
records.comment:
Decode an END-terminated stream of tile bytes and newline/wait/page controls.
WAIT consumes a following frame-count byte. The source must remain readable
through blocking waits; the routine does not validate stream length.

Decode the same text controls while fetching each byte from the specified
ROM bank. The pointer advances within that bank; it does not roll into the next bank.

definition.name: text_print_far

records.name: script_step
records.comment:
Execute commands until an output/choice yields (0), a wait yields (1), or
execution ends (2). Control/flag commands continue within the same call, so
a script loop without a yielding command can block the game loop indefinitely.

definition.name: script_step
definition.comment:
Execute commands until an output/choice yields (0), a wait yields (1), or
execution ends (2). Control/flag commands continue within the same call, so
a script loop without a yielding command can block the game loop indefinitely.

records.name: script_wait_frames
records.comment:
Set the number of subsequent script_step calls to spend waiting. Frame-based
timing requires the application to call script_step once per frame.

definition.name: script_wait_frames
definition.comment:
Set the number of subsequent script_step calls to spend waiting. Frame-based
timing requires the application to call script_step once per frame.

records.name: menu_run
records.comment:
Run a blocking menu loop with wraparound up/down selection, A to accept
and B to cancel. Return 0xFF for an empty menu or cancellation. Item strings
and menu dimensions must fit the visible tile area.

definition.name: menu_run
definition.comment:
Run a blocking menu loop with wraparound up/down selection, A to accept
and B to cancel. Return 0xFF for an empty menu or cancellation. Item strings
and menu dimensions must fit the visible tile area.
Pass a non-null menu and readable item strings. Initial prev=0 treats a button already held on entry
as a new press; A wins over B when both occur together in this blocking API.

records.name: menu_yesno
records.comment: Open a two-choice dialog and return the text-choice result (YES first, NO second).

definition.name: menu_yesno
definition.comment: Open a two-choice dialog and return the text-choice result (YES first, NO second).

records.name: menu_inventory
records.signature: u8 menu_inventory(const item_t* items, u8 count);
records.comment:
Run a blocking item menu, drawing names and two-digit quantities. Return
the selected index or 0xFF on empty input/B; this does not consume an item.

definition.name: menu_inventory
definition.signature: u8 menu_inventory(const item_t* items, u8 count);
definition.comment:
Run a blocking item menu, drawing names and two-digit quantities. Return
the selected index or 0xFF on empty input/B; this does not consume an item.
Use at most 15 visible items for this fixed dialog placement; quantities must be below 100.
Long names are not clipped and can overwrite the quantity column.

records.name: menu_init_state
records.args: menu_state_t* state, u8 x, u8 y, u8 w, u8 h, const u8* const* items, u8 count
records.signature: void menu_init_state(menu_state_t* state, u8 x, u8 y, u8 w, u8 h, const u8* const* items, u8 count);
records.comment:
Initialize a nonblocking menu state that borrows the item pointer table.
Selection starts unset (0xFF), and the cancellation flag starts clear.

definition.name: menu_init_state
definition.args: menu_state_t* state, u8 x, u8 y, u8 w, u8 h, const u8* const* items, u8 count
definition.signature: void menu_init_state(menu_state_t* state, u8 x, u8 y, u8 w, u8 h, const u8* const* items, u8 count);
definition.comment:
Initialize a nonblocking menu state that borrows the item pointer table.
Selection starts unset (0xFF), and the cancellation flag starts clear.
Borrow both the item table and its strings; keep them visible in the active ROM mapping.
Use non-null state storage and initialize again to clear latched completion flags.

records.name: menu_draw
records.comment:
Draw the current menu and cursor without waiting or sampling input. The
caller schedules suitable display timing and keeps item text within bounds.

definition.name: menu_draw
definition.comment:
Draw the current menu and cursor without waiting or sampling input. The
caller schedules suitable display timing and keeps item text within bounds.

records.name: menu_update
records.comment:
Sample new button presses and update cursor/selection state without drawing.
Selected and cancelled results remain latched; a B press in the same update
as A clears selection and leaves cancellation set.

definition.name: menu_update

Use metatile collision when that mode is active; otherwise read one packed
collision bit. Missing maps/out-of-range cells block movement, but a valid
ordinary map without a collision array is entirely passable.

records.name: map_draw_visible
records.comment:
Draw a 10-by-9 metatile viewport as 20-by-18 individual background tiles.
Out-of-range cells use definition zero; palette attributes are not written.
Remember the camera and clear the dirty flag after the full redraw.

definition.name: map_draw_visible

Draw a 10-by-9 metatile viewport as 20-by-18 individual background tiles.
Out-of-range cells use definition zero; palette attributes are not written.
Remember the camera and clear the dirty flag after the full redraw.
Keep camera_tx <=246 and camera_ty <=247 so adding the viewport offsets cannot wrap the byte coordinates.

records.name: map_get_metatile

definition.name: map_get_metatile

records.name: map_get_attr

definition.name: map_get_attr

records.name: map_is_solid

records.name: save_write
records.args: u8 slot, const void* data, u16 len
records.signature: u8 save_write(u8 slot, const void* data, u16 len);
records.comment:
Validate slot and payload length, write payload bytes, then write the header
and checksum. Return one after completing the writes; interruption can leave
a partially replaced slot, so this is not transactional save storage.

definition.name: save_write
definition.args: u8 slot, const void* data, u16 len
definition.signature: u8 save_write(u8 slot, const void* data, u16 len);
definition.comment:
Validate slot and payload length, write payload bytes, then write the header
and checksum. Return one after completing the writes; interruption can leave
a partially replaced slot, so this is not transactional save storage.
Supply len readable source bytes outside the RAM window being switched. Success reports completed
software writes; it does not read back hardware or verify battery-backed persistence.

records.name: save_read
records.args: u8 slot, void* data, u16 len
records.signature: u8 save_read(u8 slot, void* data, u16 len);
records.comment:
Require matching magic/version, exact requested length and a valid checksum
before copying data into the destination. Validation failure leaves the
destination unchanged. An invalid slot returns before touching RAM control;
validation failures after enabling RAM disable it before returning zero.

definition.name: save_read
definition.args: u8 slot, void* data, u16 len
definition.signature: u8 save_read(u8 slot, void* data, u16 len);
definition.comment:
Require matching magic/version, exact requested length and a valid checksum
before copying data into the destination. Validation failure leaves the
destination unchanged. An invalid slot returns before touching RAM control;
validation failures after enabling RAM disable it before returning zero.
Supply len writable destination bytes outside the banked cartridge-RAM window.
Do not allow concurrent writers between checksum validation and the subsequent copy.

records.name: save_exists
records.comment:
Validate a slot's header, payload bounds and checksum without copying the
payload out. A nonzero result means the stored record passes these checks.

definition.name: save_exists
definition.comment:
Validate a slot's header, payload bounds and checksum without copying the
payload out. A nonzero result means the stored record passes these checks.

records.name: save_init
records.comment:
Initialize the expected RAM access state and leave cartridge RAM disabled.

definition.name: save_init
definition.comment:

Existing slot contents are preserved.

records.name: save_load
records.args: u8 slot, void* data, u16 len
records.signature: u8 save_load(u8 slot, void* data, u16 len);
records.comment: Alias the checked save_read operation.

definition.name: save_load
definition.args: u8 slot, void* data, u16 len
definition.signature: u8 save_load(u8 slot, void* data, u16 len);

records.name: save_check

records.name: unit_move_range
records.comment:
Build movement costs, then convert reachable cells to one and unreachable
0xFF cells to zero. The caller provides one output byte per current-map cell
and a valid unit origin; path-search workspace limits also apply.

definition.name: unit_move_range
definition.comment:
Build movement costs, then convert reachable cells to one and unreachable
0xFF cells to zero. The caller provides one output byte per current-map cell
and a valid unit origin; path-search workspace limits also apply.

records.name: unit_attack_range
records.comment:
Mark cells whose Manhattan distance falls within the inclusive attack range.
This geometric mask does not test obstacles, line of sight or other units.

definition.name: unit_attack_range
definition.comment:
Mark cells whose Manhattan distance falls within the inclusive attack range.
This geometric mask does not test obstacles, line of sight or other units.
Keep all evaluated Manhattan distances within 0..255 because the intrinsic result is a byte.

records.name: unit_can_act
records.comment:
A unit can act only while HP is nonzero and its acted flag is clear.
The unit pointer must refer to a valid record.

definition.name: unit_can_act
definition.comment:
A unit can act only while HP is nonzero and its acted flag is clear.
The unit pointer must refer to a valid record.

records.name: path_find_bfs
records.args: u8 sx, u8 sy, u8 gx, u8 gy, u8* out_path, u8 max_len
records.signature: u8 path_find_bfs(u8 sx, u8 sy, u8 gx, u8 gy, u8* out_path, u8 max_len);
records.comment:
Find a shortest cardinal path with BFS and write direction codes 0=up,
1=right, 2=down, 3=left. Return its byte length, or zero for failure or an
already-reached goal. The caller supplies max_len output bytes and respects
the shared workspace/distance limits; excessive paths are not truncated.

definition.name: path_find_bfs
definition.args: u8 sx, u8 sy, u8 gx, u8 gy, u8* out_path, u8 max_len
definition.signature: u8 path_find_bfs(u8 sx, u8 sy, u8 gx, u8 gy, u8* out_path, u8 max_len);
definition.comment:
Find a shortest cardinal path with BFS and write direction codes 0=up,
1=right, 2=down, 3=left. Return its byte length, or zero for failure or an
already-reached goal. The caller supplies max_len output bytes and respects
the shared workspace/distance limits; excessive paths are not truncated.
Require at most 1024 cells and all explored distances below 255; max_len only limits returned output,
not the search radius. An unvisited FF distance must never become a legitimate reachable cost.

records.name: range_fill_move
records.args: u8 sx, u8 sy, u8 move, u8* out_costmap
records.signature: void range_fill_move(u8 sx, u8 sy, u8 move, u8* out_costmap);
records.comment:
Flood cardinal neighbors at unit cost, stopping expansion at the movement
limit and rejecting blocked destinations. Initialize output to 0xFF only
after validating the map and origin; invalid input leaves output unchanged.

definition.name: range_fill_move
definition.args: u8 sx, u8 sy, u8 move, u8* out_costmap
definition.signature: void range_fill_move(u8 sx, u8 sy, u8 move, u8* out_costmap);
definition.comment:
Flood cardinal neighbors at unit cost, stopping expansion at the movement
limit and rejecting blocked destinations. Initialize output to 0xFF only
after validating the map and origin; invalid input leaves output unchanged.
Require width*height <=1024 and move <=254; neither limit is checked here.
The origin is seeded even if its own cell is blocked, allowing paths out of that cell.

records.name: rle_decode
records.signature: u16 rle_decode(void* dst, const void* src);

definition.name: rle_decode
definition.signature: u16 rle_decode(void* dst, const void* src);
definition.comment:
Expand count/value byte pairs until a zero count terminates the stream.
The caller must provide a valid terminator and sufficient destination storage;
there are no source or destination bounds parameters. Return the 16-bit byte count.
Use writable RAM for the output, keep input/output from overlapping, and keep the
expanded size within u16. This decoder does not synchronize writes to VRAM.

records.name: rle_decode_far
records.args: void* dst, u8 bank, const void* src
records.signature: u16 rle_decode_far(void* dst, u8 bank, const void* src);
records.comment:
Decode the same count/value format using bank-qualified reads for every source
byte. Keep the encoded stream within the supplied bank/address mapping and
provide enough destination space; a zero count ends the stream.

definition.name: rle_decode_far
definition.args: void* dst, u8 bank, const void* src
definition.signature: u16 rle_decode_far(void* dst, u8 bank, const void* src);
definition.comment:
Decode the same count/value format using bank-qualified reads for every source
byte. Keep the encoded stream within the supplied bank/address mapping and
provide enough destination space; a zero count ends the stream.
The bank argument stays fixed while the source address advances; no bank-boundary rollover occurs.
Output must be writable RAM with a representable expanded size, as in rle_decode.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_Init
records.comment:
Initialize the CGB-only 128x96 renderer: enable double speed, turn the
LCD off at VBlank, clear both tile banks, load HUD/generated tiles, and
install a 16x12 column-major viewport. Start with blank tile bank 1, scroll
zero, default BG palettes, color 2 and a zero camera. Reset queues and
clear the bank-2 stage. Call BeginFrame before drawing to initialize
occlusion state. Initialization replaces LCD/tile/map state globally.

definition.name: Wire3DCGB_Init

install a 16x12 column-major viewport. Start with blank tile bank 1, scroll
zero, default BG palettes, color 2 and a zero camera. Reset queues and
clear the bank-2 stage. Call BeginFrame before drawing to initialize
occlusion state. Initialization replaces LCD/tile/map state globally.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_InitFullScreen
records.comment:
Initialize the CGB-only 160x144 tile allocator. Clear both tile banks
and map 9800, set scroll/palettes/color/camera, reset tile counts and
lookup/span state, then enable unsigned BG tile addressing. HUD tiles
are not loaded. Reserve its fixed WRAM lookup, payload and address lists
and keep the same WRAM bank mapped through full-screen rendering.

definition.name: Wire3DCGB_InitFullScreen
definition.comment:
Initialize the CGB-only 160x144 tile allocator. Clear both tile banks
and map 9800, set scroll/palettes/color/camera, reset tile counts and
lookup/span state, then enable unsigned BG tile addressing. HUD tiles
are not loaded. Reserve its fixed WRAM lookup, payload and address lists
and keep the same WRAM bank mapped through full-screen rendering.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_InitFastMapLite
records.comment:
Initialize a CGB tile-map renderer with HUD and 48 precomputed outline
tiles. Clear tile VRAM/maps, reset scroll/palettes/camera and select normal
mode. This omits normal pixel-viewport map layout and generated cube stamps;
use the FastMap APIs for this mode. Clear the bank-2 stage and mark fast
map preparation pending. Full-runtime build required.

definition.name: Wire3DCGB_InitFastMapLite
definition.comment:

use the FastMap APIs for this mode. Clear the bank-2 stage and mark fast
map preparation pending. Full-runtime build required.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_EnableDoubleSpeed
records.comment:

the speed switch and call the STOP helper. This API assumes CGB hardware
and does not provide a monochrome fallback.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_SetLineColor
records.comment:
Store color & 3. Use the named line colors 1..3: normal lines OR their
bitplanes, so intersecting colors combine; full-screen fast lines replace
the pixel color. Line color zero is treated as 3, not as an eraser.
Normal-mode point drawing separately supports color zero for erasure.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_ClearFrameTiles
records.comment:
For the 128x96 renderer, wait for VBlank, disable the LCD, clear the stage
and frame tile ranges in both banks, reset map attributes, then enable LCDC
0x81. Clear dirty flags/counts but not sparse min/max history. This does
not reset full_mode and is not a full-screen reinitializer.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_BeginFrame
records.comment:
In normal mode, select full-stage transfer, clear all staged pixels and
the bitmap mask, reset mask bounds, and disable occlusion. In full-screen
mode, reset that mode's allocator/spans instead. Pending BG writes remain queued.
Full-runtime build required.

definition.name: Wire3DCGB_BeginFrame

records.name: Wire3DCGB_BeginFrameFast
records.comment:
Perform the same normal/full-screen frame reset as BeginFrame, while
first marking both previous sparse-history ranges as the entire 192-tile
viewport. This prevents a subsequent sparse upload from trusting stale banks.

definition.name: Wire3DCGB_BeginFrameFast

records.name: Wire3DCGB_BeginFrameSparse
records.comment:
Select sparse transfer and clear the entire 128x96 stage, avoiding stale
pixels when the dirty range expands. Reset mask bounds and disable
occlusion; PAINTER_ONLY builds skip clearing the unused bitmap mask.
Full-screen mode delegates to its own allocator reset.

definition.name: Wire3DCGB_BeginFrameSparse

records.name: Wire3DCGB_ClearSparseStageFast
records.comment:
Clear the entire bank-2 stage and mark the full 128x96 viewport dirty.
Despite its name this is not a partial clear and does not preserve staged
pixels. It neither clears occlusion nor selects a transfer mode.

records.signature: void Wire3DCGB_MarkDirtyRect2D(w3dcgb_u8 min_x, w3dcgb_u8 min_y, w3dcgb_u8 max_x, w3dcgb_u8 max_y);

records.name: Wire3DCGB_DrawModelScaled
records.args: const Wire3DCGB_Model* model, w3dcgb_i16 x, w3dcgb_i16 y, w3dcgb_i16 z, w3dcgb_i8 rx, w3dcgb_i8 ry, w3dcgb_i8 rz, w3dcgb_i16 scale_q8
records.signature: void Wire3DCGB_DrawModelScaled(const Wire3DCGB_Model* model, w3dcgb_i16 x, w3dcgb_i16 y, w3dcgb_i16 z, w3dcgb_i8 rx, w3dcgb_i8 ry, w3dcgb_i8 rz, w3dcgb_i16 scale_q8);
records.comment:
Project up to 24 vertices with positive Q8 scale; nonpositive scale means
unity. Skip unity multiplication and zero-angle rotations. Intermediates
must fit s16. Build up to 16 front-face flags when adjacency filtering is
available, then draw depth-valid edges with valid vertex indices. The model
edge count is not capped at 64. There is no near-plane clipping. Replace
the shared projection cache and OR line colors into the normal 128x96 stage.
This path does not mark sparse bounds; arrange a full upload or explicitly
invalidate frame history before a sparse upload.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_EraseModelFaces
records.args: const Wire3DCGB_Model* model, w3dcgb_i16 x, w3dcgb_i16 y, w3dcgb_i16 z, w3dcgb_i8 rx, w3dcgb_i8 ry, w3dcgb_i8 rz, w3dcgb_i16 scale_q8
records.signature: void Wire3DCGB_EraseModelFaces(const Wire3DCGB_Model* model, w3dcgb_i16 x, w3dcgb_i16 y, w3dcgb_i16 z, w3dcgb_i8 rx, w3dcgb_i8 ry, w3dcgb_i8 rz, w3dcgb_i16 scale_q8);
records.comment:
For a hidden-line model with vertices/faces, transform at most 24 vertices
and erase front-facing triangles among at most 16 faces. Nonpositive scale
means unity; this path still multiplies at unity and runs all three rotation
helpers at zero angles. Reject invalid/depth-failed faces. Replace the shared
projection cache and use the normal C stage clearer, which requires the
caller or allocation to provide the correct WRAM mapping.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_DrawLineClipped2D
records.args: w3dcgb_i16 x0, w3dcgb_i16 y0, w3dcgb_i16 x1, w3dcgb_i16 y1, w3dcgb_u8 color
records.signature: void Wire3DCGB_DrawLineClipped2D(w3dcgb_i16 x0, w3dcgb_i16 y0, w3dcgb_i16 x1, w3dcgb_i16 y1, w3dcgb_u8 color);
records.comment:
Signed endpoints, clipped before conversion to the rasterizer's u8 ABI. 
Clip a signed 2D line to the selected viewport, then draw with temporary
color. Inputs outside +/-2047 are rejected. Fully in-bounds 128x96 lines
use a fast path; other lines use outcodes and bounded integer intersections
with an eight-iteration guard. Accepted normal-mode lines mark dirty bounds.
This is screen clipping only, with no 3D projection or depth clipping.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_ProjectAxis48
records.comment:
Approximate value*48/z without a camera or screen-center offset. Negative
or very small Z becomes 4. For Z above 255, shift depth and magnitude
right together until depth fits a byte, then cap magnitude at 160.
Return a signed offset; this helper does not reject near/far depths.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_InvalidateFrameHistory
records.comment:

tiles. Pixel data is not cleared; subsequent uploads cannot trust old ranges.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_EnableAtomicMaps
records.comment:
Startup-only: reserves both BG maps; queued HUD tiles are mirrored. 
Enable map flipping once during 128x96 startup; ignore full-screen mode
or an already-enabled setting. With LCD on, wait for VBlank, disable it,
copy both banks of 9800 to 9C00, and assign viewport attributes to tile
banks 0/1 respectively. Restore LCDC with map 9C00 selected and VBK zero.
Both BG maps become reserved. Queued HUD tile numbers are mirrored.

definition.name: Wire3DCGB_EnableAtomicMaps
definition.comment:
Enable map flipping once during 128x96 startup; ignore full-screen mode
or an already-enabled setting. With LCD on, wait for VBlank, disable it,
copy both banks of 9800 to 9C00, and assign viewport attributes to tile
banks 0/1 respectively. Restore LCDC with map 9C00 selected and VBK zero.
Both BG maps become reserved. Queued HUD tile numbers are mirrored.
definition.body:
void Wire3DCGB_EnableAtomicMaps()
{
    if ((w3dcgb_full_mode != 0) || (w3dcgb_atomic_maps != 0)) return;
    __asm {
w3dam_wait:
        LDH_A_MEM 68
        CP_IMM 144
        JR_C w3dam_wait
        LDH_A_MEM 64
        PUSH_AF
        XOR_A
        LDH_MEM_A 64
        LDH_MEM_A 79
        LD_HL_IMM 0x9800
        LD_DE_IMM 0x9C00
        LD_B_IMM 4
w3dam_copy_page:
        LD_C_IMM 0
w3dam_copy_byte:
        LD_A_HL
        INC_HL
        LD_DE_A
        INC_DE
        DEC_C
        JR_NZ w3dam_copy_byte
        DEC_B
        JR_NZ w3dam_copy_page
        LDH_A_MEM 79
        AND_IMM 1
        JR_NZ w3dam_attrs
        LD_A_IMM 1
        LDH_MEM_A 79
        LD_HL_IMM 0x9800
        LD_DE_IMM 0x9C00
        LD_B_IMM 4
        JR w3dam_copy_page
w3dam_attrs:
        LD_HL_IMM 0x9800
        LD_DE_IMM 0x9C00
        LD_B_IMM 12
w3dam_row:
        LD_C_IMM 16
w3dam_cell:
        XOR_A
        LDI_HL_A
        LD_A_IMM 8
        LD_DE_A
        INC_DE
        DEC_C
        JR_NZ w3dam_cell
        LD_A_L
        ADD_A_IMM 16
        LD_L_A
        JR_NC w3dam_hl_ready
        INC_H
w3dam_hl_ready:
        LD_A_E
        ADD_A_IMM 16
        LD_E_A
        JR_NC w3dam_de_ready
        INC_D
w3dam_de_ready:
        DEC_B
        JR_NZ w3dam_row
        LD_A_IMM 1
        LD_MEM_A w3dcgb_atomic_maps
        XOR_A
        LDH_MEM_A 79
        POP_AF
        OR_IMM 8
        LDH_MEM_A 64
        RET
    }
}

Mark a screen-space triangle without drawing pixels or enabling occlusion.
Supply vertices inside the selected viewport. The active ASM adds a one-pixel

records.name: Wire3DCGB_MarkPackedSilhouette2D
records.args: const w3dcgb_u8* profile, w3dcgb_u8 count, w3dcgb_i8 y0, w3dcgb_u8 x, w3dcgb_u8 y
records.signature: void Wire3DCGB_MarkPackedSilhouette2D(const w3dcgb_u8* profile, w3dcgb_u8 count, w3dcgb_i8 y0, w3dcgb_u8 x, w3dcgb_u8 y);
records.comment:
Mark up to 29 silhouette rows in the 128x96 bitmap mask. Each packed byte
uses its high nibble for center offset (nibble-7), low nibble for half-width;
0xFF skips a row. Place rows at y+y0+i, expand spans by two pixels, and clip
to the viewport. profile must contain count readable bytes; null is ignored.
This does not update full-screen spans or enable occlusion.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_ErasePackedSilhouette2D
records.args: const w3dcgb_u8* profile, w3dcgb_u8 count, w3dcgb_i8 y0, w3dcgb_u8 x, w3dcgb_u8 y
records.signature: void Wire3DCGB_ErasePackedSilhouette2D(const w3dcgb_u8* profile, w3dcgb_u8 count, w3dcgb_i8 y0, w3dcgb_u8 x, w3dcgb_u8 y);
records.comment:
Erase up to 29 packed silhouette rows from both staged bitplanes. Format,
placement, two-pixel guard and clipping match MarkPackedSilhouette2D; null
is ignored. The ASM span writer selects/restores WRAM bank 2 but does not
mark dirty tiles. In sparse mode the caller must ensure erased tiles are
included in the upload range. This API targets the 128x96 stage.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_DrawScene
records.comment:
Sort at most eight objects near-to-far by camera-space origin depth,
without changing the caller array. Clear the mask, draw visible models
against earlier coverage, then add their faces as occluders. Model arrays
and face indices must be valid. Color zero inherits the current color,
possibly from the preceding object. Restore entry color and disable
occlusion at the end. This model path targets the normal 128x96 stage.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_DrawFastCubeFrame
records.args: Wire3DCGB_FastCube* cubes, w3dcgb_u8 count, w3dcgb_u8 hidden_enabled, w3dcgb_u8 selected
records.signature: void Wire3DCGB_DrawFastCubeFrame(Wire3DCGB_FastCube* cubes, w3dcgb_u8 count, w3dcgb_u8 hidden_enabled, w3dcgb_u8 selected);
records.comment:
Prepare the map, erase prior bounds/status cells, sort up to three cube
stamps far-to-near by raw Z, then draw and upload numbers/attributes at
VBlank. The caller array is not reordered. Non-null count zero clears
old stamps; a null array is a complete no-op. selected & 3 chooses the
status cell only, not a cube highlight. Requires loaded cube stamps, the
full runtime and consistent FastMap WRAM mapping; it does not initialize them.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_FastMapCell
records.args: w3dcgb_u8 tx, w3dcgb_u8 ty, w3dcgb_u8 color, w3dcgb_u8 mask
records.signature: void Wire3DCGB_FastMapCell(w3dcgb_u8 tx, w3dcgb_u8 ty, w3dcgb_u8 color, w3dcgb_u8 mask);
records.comment:
Add outline sides to a cell: bits 1/2/4/8 mean top/bottom/left/right.
Same-color masks combine; another color replaces the old mask. Zero mask
is ignored, zero color means MAIN, and color above 3 clamps to 3. Target
the 16x12 shadow with stable WRAM mapping; full runtime required.

Order and clip byte tile coordinates to 16x12, then replace selected
border cells. Side bits 1/2/4/8 mean top/bottom/left/right. Zero color
means MAIN; values above 3 clamp to 3. Attributes and interior cells remain.

are overwritten in sequence. Requires full runtime and stable WRAM mapping.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_FastMapFlush
records.comment:
Wait for a fresh VBlank when LCD is enabled, then upload the first
twelve complete map rows of tile numbers and attributes to map 9800.
LCD-off callers proceed immediately. Requires the full runtime, stable
WRAM mapping and enough safe time for both immediate GDMA transfers.

records.args: w3dcgb_i16 ax, w3dcgb_i16 ay, w3dcgb_i16 az, w3dcgb_i16 bx, w3dcgb_i16 by, w3dcgb_i16 bz
records.signature: void Wire3DCGB_DrawLine3D(w3dcgb_i16 ax, w3dcgb_i16 ay, w3dcgb_i16 az, w3dcgb_i16 bx, w3dcgb_i16 by, w3dcgb_i16 bz);
records.comment:
Project both endpoints through the camera into the 128x96 viewport.
Reject the whole line if either endpoint fails the depth test; do not clip
near-plane crossings. DrawLine2D dispatches by mode, but projection remains
128x96. Normal lines accumulate color planes and do not mark sparse bounds;
use a full upload or explicitly invalidate frame history for sparse upload.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_DrawPoint2D
records.comment:
In normal mode, reject coordinates outside 128x96, mark sparse bounds
and replace the staged pixel using the current color, including zero.
Full-screen mode draws a coincident-endpoint fast line instead, so zero
means color 3 and invalid coordinates latch that frame's overflow flag.
Display transfer occurs later.

and replace the staged pixel using the current color, including zero.
Full-screen mode draws a coincident-endpoint fast line instead, so zero
means color 3 and invalid coordinates latch that frame's overflow flag.
Display transfer occurs later.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_EndFrame
records.comment:
Normal mode flushes queued BG writes, transfers the full stage and
presents the completed tile bank. Full-screen mode transfers/presents its
allocated tiles and does not flush the HUD queue. Requires an enabled LCD
and the transfer helpers' bank/interrupt contracts; may span multiple frames.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_EndFrameSparse
records.comment:
In normal mode, wait for a fresh VBlank and invoke EndFrameSparseNow.
Full-screen mode uses its full transfer/presentation instead. Requires the
full runtime and an enabled LCD; it is not guaranteed to complete in one frame.

definition.name: Wire3DCGB_EndFrameSparse
definition.comment:
In normal mode, wait for a fresh VBlank and invoke EndFrameSparseNow.
Full-screen mode uses its full transfer/presentation instead. Requires the
full runtime and an enabled LCD; it is not guaranteed to complete in one frame.

records.name: Wire3DCGB_EndFrameSparseNow
records.comment:
Flush queued BG writes, upload the sparse current/N-2 tile range to the
back bank and present it. Skip the initial fresh-VBlank wait, but normal
map mode still waits when restoring its blank HUD tile; DMA/presentation
may also wait. Full-runtime full-screen mode delegates to its own path.
Require an enabled LCD and keep SVBK/VBK stable while DMA is active.

records.name: Wire3DDMG_Init
records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 96
void Wire3DDMG_Init();
Take over the LCD: wait for VBlank, switch it off, clear 6144 tile bytes and
the BG map, install HUD tiles and the 128x96 signed-tile viewport, then enable
BG display with scroll zero and BGP=0xB4. Reset camera, BG queue and stage.
Reserve 0xD000..0xDFFF for staging and retain its WRAM bank mapping.
Call BeginFrame before drawing to initialize the occlusion state as well.

WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120
void Wire3DDMG_Init();
Take over LCD state, clear tile VRAM and the BG map, and install a 16x15
viewport beginning at map tile (3,1). Set scroll (8,0), BGP=0xB4 and BG display.
Reset camera, queues, transfer modes, both dirty tables and stage. Reserve
0xD000..0xDFFF and retain its WRAM mapping; auxiliary storage aliases it.
Call BeginFrame before drawing to establish occlusion state.

records.comment:

Clear staged pixels and occlusion mask and disable occlusion filtering.
This leaves the displayed VRAM frame and pending BG tile queue unchanged.

WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120

Disable occlusion filtering only. Stage clearing normally happens during
transfer, and Init supplies the first clean stage. This does not discard an
unsubmitted frame, clear the mask, or reset pending BG writes/dirty flags.

Scale, rotate in Y/X/Z order, translate and project at most 24 vertices;
then draw up to 16 edges filtered by yaw masks and optional front-facing faces.
Nonpositive scale becomes unity (256). Null model/vertex/edge pointers are
ignored; referenced tables must remain readable. Keep scale products and
translations in signed 16-bit range. Depth-crossing edges are dropped, not clipped.

Scale up to 24 vertices, rotate Y/X/Z, translate and project, then traverse
all edge_count entries (a byte count) with optional adjacent-face filtering.
Face scratch is capped at 16; edge tables must contain all declared entries.
Nonpositive scale means 256. Null model/vertex/edge pointers are ignored.
Keep products/translations in signed 16-bit range; depth-crossing edges are dropped.

records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 96
void Wire3DDMG_DrawScene(Wire3DDMG_Object* objects, w3ddmg_u8 count);
Process at most the first eight objects, sorted near to far by transformed
origin depth. Draw visible valid models, then mark their front-face bounding
rectangles to reject fully sampled later lines. This approximates inter-object
occlusion, not a depth buffer. It clears its mask but retains existing staged
pixels. Null arrays are ignored; objects and their data must remain readable.

WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120
void Wire3DDMG_DrawScene(Wire3DDMG_Object* objects, w3ddmg_u8 count);
Sort at most eight object origins by camera depth, near to far. Draw visible
valid models and mark front-face bounding rectangles for later objects. The
first sorted slot bypasses mask tests and the last needs no new occluder.
This is coarse line rejection, not a depth buffer. Null/empty input is ignored;
caller data and the current projection cache must remain valid during traversal.

records.name: Wire3D_Init
records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 96.
Take over the LCD: wait for VBlank, switch it off, clear 6144 tile bytes and
the BG map, install HUD tiles and the 128x96 signed-tile viewport, then enable
BG display with scroll zero and BGP=0xB4. Reset camera, BG queue and stage.
Reserve 0xD000..0xDFFF for staging and retain its WRAM bank mapping.
Call BeginFrame before drawing to initialize the occlusion state as well.

WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 96.

roll and camera orientation are ignored. Use 16, 8, 4 or 2 bins; other positive

records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Scale up to 24 vertices, rotate Y/X/Z, translate and project, then traverse
all edge_count entries (a byte count) with optional adjacent-face filtering.

Nonpositive scale means 256. Null model/vertex/edge pointers are ignored.
Keep products/translations in signed 16-bit range; depth-crossing edges are dropped.

records.name: DMG3D_DrawScene
records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Sort at most eight object origins by camera depth, near to far. Draw visible
valid models and mark front-face bounding rectangles for later objects. The
first sorted slot bypasses mask tests and the last needs no new occluder.
This is coarse line rejection, not a depth buffer. Null/empty input is ignored;
caller data and the current projection cache must remain valid during traversal.

records.name: DMG3D_EndFrame
records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Wait for the next VBlank and flush BG writes, then optionally consume the
auxiliary strips before uploading either dirty tiles or the entire main stage.
Auxiliary/main source overlap makes that ordering significant. STAT polling
continues across access windows; the update need not fit one VBlank.

records.signature: void DMG3D_RotatePoint(w3ddmg_i16* x, w3ddmg_i16* y, w3ddmg_i16* z, w3ddmg_u8 rx, w3ddmg_u8 ry, w3ddmg_u8 rz);
records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Rotate in place in Y/X/Z order using 16 steps per full turn. A null
component pointer makes the whole call a no-op; use distinct pointers.
Each axis rotation clamps its inputs to +/-220.

records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Store the EndFrame auxiliary-transfer gate; any nonzero value enables it.
No data is copied or cleared here. Auxiliary source bytes alias the main stage.

records.name: DMG3D_SetCamera
records.args: w3ddmg_i16 x, w3ddmg_i16 y, w3ddmg_i16 z, w3ddmg_u8 pitch, w3ddmg_u8 yaw, w3ddmg_u8 roll
records.signature: void DMG3D_SetCamera(w3ddmg_i16 x, w3ddmg_i16 y, w3ddmg_i16 z, w3ddmg_u8 pitch, w3ddmg_u8 yaw, w3ddmg_u8 roll);
records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Store camera position and angles for later draws; a full turn is 16 angle
steps. No existing drawing is reprojected and no input range validation occurs.

records.name: DMG3D_SetDirtyTransfer
records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Store the dirty-transfer gate and clear both dirty histories and the main
stage, even if the value is unchanged. VRAM is retained; enabling this over an
old image can leave unmarked old tiles, so arrange a clean displayed baseline.

records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Write the raw DMG BGP palette encoding immediately; no frame synchronization occurs.

records.name: DMG3D_TransferAuxNow
records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Upload and consume auxiliary source strips immediately, independent of the
auxiliary gate. No VBlank-start wait or dirty-history/BG-queue update occurs.
The source overlaps the main stage and must be coordinated with its upload.

records.name: DMG3D_TransferMainNow
records.comment:
WIRE3D_DMG_HEIGHT = 120.
Upload and consume the full main stage immediately, polling STAT but not
waiting for the next VBlank. Ignore transfer gates and leave dirty histories
and BG tile queue unchanged; the caller coordinates the frame lifecycle.
